blocks.text: Nucleic acids nucleotide units ke polymers hain. Nucleic acids ki do bari qismein hain: deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) aur ribonucleic acid (RNA). DNA zyada tar chromosomes mein milta hai, aur thori miqdar mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein. RNA nucleolus, ribosomes aur cytosol mein milta hai. Nucleotide ek nucleoside aur phosphoric acid se bana hota hai, aur nucleoside ek nitrogen base aur ek pentose (5 carbon wali) sugar se (Figure 4.39).

blocks.alt: Flow chart: Nucleic acid (rangeen ikaiyon ka sutoon) -> Nucleotide -> Nucleoside aur Phosphoric acid; Nucleoside -> Nitrogen base aur Pentose sugar.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.39: Nucleic acids ke ajza (kitab ki Figure 4.39 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pentose sugars: RNA mein ribose aur DNA mein deoxyribose pentose sugar hoti hai.

Nitrogenous bases: nucleic acids mein do qisam ke nitrogenous bases hain: pyrimidines aur purines. Pyrimidine ek ring wala base hai. Nucleic acids mein teen pyrimidines hain: cytosine (C) DNA aur RNA dono mein, thymine (T) sirf DNA mein, aur uracil (U) sirf RNA mein. Purine do rings wala base hai. DNA aur RNA dono mein do purines hain: adenine (A) aur guanine (G). Jab ek nitrogenous base pentose sugar ke carbon 1 se jurta hai to nucleoside banta hai.

Phosphoric acid: nucleoside phosphoric acid ke saath ester linkage (jor) bana kar nucleotide ban jata hai. Is ester linkage mein phosphoric acid pentose sugar ke C-5 (carbon number 5) se jurta hai. Nucleic acids ka backbone (bunyadi dhancha) sugars aur phosphates se bana hai (Figure 4.40).

blocks.alt: Saya-daar khara backbone jis mein phosphates (P) aur pentose sugar rings baari baari hain; har sugar se ek base (ek ya do rings) daayen taraf nikalta hai. Labels: Backbone, Bases.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.40: Nucleic acids ka sugar-phosphate backbone (kitab ki Figure 4.40 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Paanch nucleotides, har ek pentose ring (carbons 1 se 5, ring ka O), carbon 5 par P aur carbon 1 par base. Pyrimidines (ek chhe kone ring): cytosine, thymine aur uracil. Purines (chhe kone ring jo ek kinare se paanch kone ring se juri hai): adenine aur guanine.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.41: RNA aur DNA ke nucleotides (kitab ki Figure 4.41 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar ke teen bases (cytosine, thymine, uracil) ek ring wale pyrimidines hain; neeche ke do (adenine, guanine) do rings wale purines hain, jin mein chhe kone aur paanch kone rings ek kinara share karti hain. Har base sugar ke carbon 1 se aur phosphate (P) sugar ke carbon 5 se jura hai. Thymine aur uracil mein sirf CH₃ ka farq hai.
Formation of phosphodiester bond (phosphodiester bond ka banna)

Hum jante hain ke ek nucleotide mein phosphoric acid pentose sugar ke C-5 se ester linkage banata hai. Yahi phosphoric acid doosre nucleotide ki pentose sugar ke C-3 se ek aur ester linkage bana leta hai. Is tarah har phosphoric acid ke do pentose sugars ke saath do ester linkages hote hain (ek C-5 par, doosra C-3 par). In do ester linkages ko mila kar phosphodiester linkage kehte hain (Figure 4.42). Yahi linkage do nucleotides ko jorti hai.

blocks.alt: Do nucleotides: upar wale ki sugar par cytosine aur carbon 5 par P-O; us ki sugar ka carbon 3, O-P-O ke zariye neeche wali sugar ke carbon 5 se jura hai, jis par adenine hai. O-P-O jor par bracket aur label Phosphodiester linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.42: Ek dinucleotide (kitab ki Figure 4.42 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Darmiyan wala phosphate do ester linkages banata hai: ek upar wali sugar ke carbon 3 se aur doosra neeche wali sugar ke carbon 5 se. In do ester linkages ko mila kar phosphodiester linkage kehte hain; isi tarah nucleotides zanjeer mein jurte hain.

RNA ke nucleotides ko ribonucleotides aur DNA ke nucleotides ko deoxyribonucleotides kehte hain. Nucleotides ka naam un ke nitrogenous base par rakha jata hai (maslan adenine nucleotide, cytosine nucleotide; Figure 4.41 dekhein).

Nucleotides cell ki zindagi mein aur bhi aham kaam karte hain. Maslan ATP adenine ka triphosphate nucleotide hai: is mein ek ribose sugar se teen phosphate groups jure hote hain. ATP cell ki “energy currency” hai. Yeh ek ke baad ek apne do phosphate groups alag kar ke energy deta hai aur ADP aur phir AMP ban jata hai. Isi tarah nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) ek co-enzyme (enzyme ka madadgar) hai jo cell ke oxidation–reduction reactions mein hydrogen acceptor (hydrogen lene wala) ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baayen, Adenosine Triphosphate: HO-P-O-P-O-P-O (teen phosphate groups) ribose ke carbon 5 se jure, carbon 1 par adenine. Daayen, Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide: nicotinamide ring ek ribose par, do phosphates ke zariye doosri ribose se juri jis par adenine hai. Labels: Phosphate groups, Ribose, Adenine, Nicotinamide.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.43: ATP aur NAD (kitab ki Figure 4.43 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Nucleotides phosphodiester linkages se jur kar lambi polynucleotide chains banate hain. Polynucleotide chain mein 5’ sire par phosphate group aur 3’ sire par OH group hamesha azad hota hai. RNA ek polynucleotide chain se bana hai, jabke DNA double helix hai aur do polynucleotide chains se bana hai.
Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)

Rosalind Franklin aur Maurice Wilkins ne DNA ki molecular structure (X-ray ke zariye) ka mutala kiya. James D. Watson aur Francis Crick ne 1953 mein DNA ka model pesh kiya. Chargaff ke mushahidaat (observations) bhi DNA ki structure maloom karne mein bunyadi ahmiyat rakhte thay. Watson aur Crick ke DNA model ke ahem nukaat yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Franklin ke naam ke saath 1953 aur Wilkins ke naam ke saath 1967 likha hai. Wilkins ne DNA par X-ray ka kaam 1950 se 1953 ke darmiyan Franklin ke saath kiya tha, aur 1962 mein Watson aur Crick ke saath Nobel Prize hasil kiya; 1967 is kaam ka saal nahin.

1950 mein Linus Pauling ne nateeja nikala ke DNA reshedar (fibrous) maadda hai aur yeh resha helix (kundli) mein lipta hua hai. 1951 mein Erwin Chargaff ne aham data diya jis se pata chala ke DNA mein adenine aur thymine barabar miqdar mein hain, aur guanine aur cytosine bhi barabar.

items: DNA do polynucleotide chains (strands) se bana hai.
Dono strands ek doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banate hain.
Double helix seerhi (ladder) jaisa hai. Is ke do khambe (poles) sugars aur phosphate groups se bane hain, aur is ke dande (rungs) nitrogenous bases ke joron (base pairs) se.
Har base pair (danda) ek purine (A ya G) aur ek pyrimidine (C ya T) se banta hai.
Dono strands apne bases ke darmiyan kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain.
Ek strand ka adenine doosre strand ke thymine se hydrogen bonds banata hai (ya ulat). Ek strand ka guanine doosre strand ke cytosine se hydrogen bonds banata hai (ya ulat).
A aur T ke jore mein do hydrogen bonds aur G aur C ke jore mein teen hydrogen bonds hote hain.
Dono strands phosphodiester linkages ke lihaz se ek hi simt mein nahin chalte, balke ek doosre ke ulat (anti-parallel) chalte hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Double helix 2 nm chaura; base pairs dono strands ko jorte hain; ek poora chakkar 3.4 nm aur base pairs ka faasla 0.34 nm; minor aur major grooves. (b) Sugars aur phosphates (P) ke do mukhalif-rukh (antiparallel) strands, bases ke jore C-G, A-T, C-G, G-C dashed hydrogen bonds se jure (A-T do, G-C teen). Har strand 5' phosphate se shuru aur 3' sugar par khatm hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.44: (a) Watson aur Crick ka DNA model, (b) DNA ki tafseeli banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.44 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (b) mein baayan strand upar 5' (phosphate) se neeche 3' tak chalta hai, aur daayan strand ulta: neeche 5' se upar 3' tak; isi ko antiparallel kehte hain. Har strand ke 5' sire par azaad phosphate aur 3' sire par sugar ka azaad OH hai. A-T ke darmiyan do aur G-C ke darmiyan teen hydrogen bonds hain, isi liye G-C jora zyada mazboot hai.

DNA chromosomes ka bunyadi hissa hai, is liye eukaryotes mein yeh nucleus ke andar hota hai. Prokaryotes mein alag nucleus nahin hota, is liye un ka DNA cytoplasm mein hota hai. Viruses mein DNA beech mein (core molecule) hota hai aur us par protein ka ghilaf (coat) chadha hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Eukaryotes mein DNA ki thori miqdar (taqreeban 2%) mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein bhi hoti hai.

DNA tamam jandaron ka hereditary material (wirasati maadda) hai (kuch viruses ke ilawa). DNA mein woh “program” hai jo aakhir kar cell ki saari activities ko chalata hai. DNA ka yeh program genes ki shakal mein hai. Gene DNA ke nucleotides ki woh sequence hai jo ek polypeptide banane ka code rakhti hai. Jab koi gene “ON” hota hai to DNA ke nucleotides ki sequence pehle RNA mein transcribe (copy) hoti hai aur phir khaas proteins mein translate hoti hai. Is tarah DNA cell ki khususiyaat aur activities control karta hai.
Bacterium E. coli ke chromosome mein DNA ke har strand mein taqreeban 50 lakh (5 million) bases ek khaas seedhi tarteeb mein hain. Is mein genes hain aur har gene kai sau bases ka hota hai.
Ribonucleic acid (RNA)
RNA ribonucleotides se bana hai. Transcription ke amal mein DNA ke deoxyribonucleotides ke saamne ribonucleotides jor kar RNA banaya jata hai. Har zinda cell mein teen qisam ka RNA hota hai.
1. Messenger RNA (mRNA)

mRNA ribonucleotides ka ek strand hai. Is ke nucleotides ki sequence DNA ke ek strand ki sequence ki complementary (jori wali) hoti hai. mRNA cell ke kul RNA ka taqreeban 3-4% hai. Yeh DNA ka genetic paigham ribosomes tak le jata hai taake khaas protein ban sake.
2. Transfer RNA (tRNA)

tRNA nisbatan chhota hai. Yeh helical structure hai aur is ka molecule clover (teen patti wale poday) ke patte jaisa dikhta hai. Yeh cell ke kul RNA ka 10-15% hai. Protein synthesis (protein banne) ke dauran tRNAs amino acids ko ribosome aur mRNA tak le jate hain.
3. Ribosomal RNA (rRNA)

rRNA nucleoli ke DNA se banta hai. Banne ke baad rRNA ribosomal proteins se jur jata hai aur ribosomes bante hain. Yeh cell ke kul RNA ka taqreeban 80% hai. rRNA ribosomes mein proteins banane ki machinery ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek lipta hua strand: neela sugar-phosphate backbone jis se rangeen nitrogen wale bases nikle hain. Labels: Sugar-Phosphate backbone, Nitrogenous bases.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.45: RNA ki banawat ka model (kitab ki Figure 4.45 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Central dogma

Tamam jandar genes ko parhne aur zahir (express) karne ka ek hi bunyadi tareeqa istemal karte hain, jise central dogma kehte hain. Central dogma ka pehla qadam DNA se RNA tak maloomat ka jana hai; yeh tab hota hai jab gene ki RNA copy banti hai. Is amal ko transcription kehte hain. Doosra qadam RNA se protein tak maloomat ka jana hai; yeh tab hota hai jab RNA mein mojood maloomat se protein banaya jata hai. Is amal ko translation kehte hain. Is tarah DNA cell ki khususiyaat aur activities control karta hai.

blocks.alt: DNA (double helix) -> teer, Transcription (DNA -> RNA) -> RNA (bases wala ek strand) -> teer, Translation (RNA -> Protein) -> Protein (motiyon ki zanjeer).

blocks.prompt: DNA ka ek strand 5'-ATGGCA-3' hai. Complementary strand us ke siron (5' aur 3') ke saath likhein, chhe joron mein kul hydrogen bonds ginein, aur woh do qadam batayein jin se yeh gene protein ban sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Complementary strand: 3'-TACCGT-5' (anti-parallel). A-T jore mein do aur G-C jore mein teen hydrogen bonds: A-T, T-A, G-C, G-C, C-G, A-T = 2 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 15. Pehle transcription gene ko RNA mein copy karti hai, phir translation RNA se protein banati hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Nucleic acids nucleotides ke polymers hain. Nucleotide = pentose (RNA mein ribose, DNA mein deoxyribose) + nitrogenous base (pyrimidines C, T, U ek ring; purines A, G do rings) + C-5 par phosphate. Base + sugar = nucleoside.

Phosphodiester linkage phosphate ke zariye ek sugar ke C-5 ko agli sugar ke C-3 se jorti hai; chain ka 5’ phosphate aur 3’ OH azad hota hai. ATP (adenine, ribose, teen phosphates) energy currency hai; NAD hydrogen lene wala co-enzyme hai.

DNA (Watson aur Crick, 1953): do anti-parallel strands ka double helix; sugar-phosphate khambe, purine-pyrimidine dande; A-T do aur G-C teen hydrogen bonds. Gene polypeptide ka code hai; DNA hereditary material hai (kuch viruses ke ilawa).
RNA ek strand: mRNA (3-4%, paigham), tRNA (10-15%, clover leaf, amino acids), rRNA (80%, ribosomes). Central dogma: DNA → RNA (transcription) → protein (translation).
